newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA METALS STEADY ON LOW DEMAND, FEW ARRIVALS.
newsitem.headline: INDIA METALS STEADY ON LOW DEMAND, FEW ARRIVALS.

text.p: Base metals were steady in limited activity despite low demand from industrial consumers remained low but scattered arrivals kept prices at the previous level, on the local market, dealers said.

Copper was steady at 13,200 rupees per quintal so was zinc at 8,400 rupees and lead at 4,200 rupees per quintal amid nominal trade. Arrivals of imported metals remained slow but scattered offerings by state-owned producers kept supplies at a satisfactory level.
Tin was available at the previous level of 29,200 rupees as was nickel at 34,100 rupees and aluminium at 7,800 rupees per quintal.
"Reports of narrow movement in the world market also kept local prices in a limited range," one dealer said.
